descriptors.concept_name: CARRY FORWARD AND SET OFF OF LOSSES NOT PERMISSIBLE IN CERTAIN CASES [SECTION 119]
descriptors.definition: Unabsorbed business losses proportionate to a retired or deceased partner cannot be carried forward upon a firm constitution change, though unabsorbed depreciation remains eligible. Similarly, business succession otherwise than by inheritance bars the successor from carrying forward the predecessor's losses, whereas succession by inheritance permits such carry forward.
inclusion: unabsorbed depreciation carry forward despite partnership constitution changes
business loss carry forward by legal heirs in succession by inheritance
exclusion: carry forward of partner's proportionate loss upon retirement or death
carry forward of predecessor business losses by non-inheriting successors
nearby_distinctions: Distinguishes between restrictions on unabsorbed business losses versus unabsorbed depreciation during constitution changes or non-inheritance successions.

descriptors.concept_name: NO SET OFF OF LOSSES AGAINST UNDISCLOSED INCOME CONSEQUENT TO SEARCH, REQUISITION AND SURVEY [SECTION 120]
descriptors.definition: Brought forward losses, current losses, and unabsorbed depreciation cannot be set off against undisclosed income uncovered during statutory searches, requisitions, or qualifying surveys. Undisclosed income encompasses unrecorded assets, transactions, or incorrect expense and deduction claims for the block period.
inclusion: prohibition of loss set-off against undisclosed assets or transactions
restriction on offsetting unabsorbed depreciation against discovered income
nearby_distinctions: Distinguishes standard business income and regular loss adjustments from punitive non-set-off rules applied exclusively to discovered undisclosed income.

descriptors.concept_name: Order Of Set Off Of Losses
descriptors.definition: Statutory rules dictate a specific sequence for deducting current allowances, brought-forward business losses, and unabsorbed depreciation against income. Brought-forward unabsorbed depreciation is combined with current depreciation and treated as current year allowance rather than business loss.
inclusion: prioritizing current year depreciation over brought-forward business losses
treating brought-forward unabsorbed depreciation as part of current depreciation
exclusion: treating brought-forward unabsorbed depreciation as business loss under section 112
nearby_distinctions: Contrasts the sequencing of business loss utilization against depreciation allowances and scientific research expenditures.

descriptors.definition: Carrying forward specified capital, business, speculation, and specified activity losses requires filing a valid loss return within the statutory timeframe. House property losses and unabsorbed depreciation are exempt from this mandatory return-filing prerequisite for carry forward.
inclusion: mandating timely loss return submission for business and capital losses
exempting house property loss and unabsorbed depreciation from filing preconditions
exclusion: carrying forward specified losses without a timely filed return under section 263(1)
nearby_distinctions: Differentiates losses requiring mandatory return filing for carry-forward eligibility from those like house property losses that retain carry-forward rights regardless.
